verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Zechariah 6

Two bronze mountains (perhaps Olives and Zion); four chariots = "four spirits of heaven", agents of judgment; identification with Daniel's empires noted and set aside (colours like Rev 6); the north country (Babylon) where the Spirit is at rest; gifts from Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah; a royal crown on the high priest is "unthinkable" except as prophecy of the King-Priest Jesus; "liberal critics" who would crown Zerubbabel miss the point; "Behold the Man" and the Branch who builds the temple of God's people
